notes: MediaPipe Face Mesh index -> MakeHuman base-mesh point (three vertex ids + barycentric weights) on Kai's starting head (male, 32, South Asian mix), found by running the detector on renders of the head (raster.py) and tracing each point back onto the mesh. 'front': a frontal view; 'photo_view': the reference photo's camera and pose (outline points differ: they follow the silhouette of the view); spread_mm: the distance between the two on the head (small for interior points).
